topic: What Google looks for before showing you in the map pack
caption:
Google's map pack does not pick businesses randomly.

Proximity, relevance, prominence. Those are the three factors Google uses. You can't move your shop, but you can control the other two.

A properly built website with your city name, your services, and consistent business info tells Google exactly who you are and who you serve.

We build sites for High Desert businesses that are set up to rank from day one. DM us 'MAP' to see how.
